title: CE60125: Numerical Methods In Structural Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Error in numerical computations; solution of nonlinear equations; solution of
linear system of equations; interpolation and polynomial approximation; curve
fitting; numerical differentiation and integration; solution of ordinary
differential equation (ODE); solution of partial differential equation (PDE);
Eigen Values and Eigen Vectors; Error analysis
